title: AI industry money could hurt candidates in close US Senate races
teaser: A survey of more than 3,000 likely voters in Iowa, Michigan and Ohio found that three-quarters would be less likely to vote for a candidate who accepted money from an AI-supporting super PAC. With close Senate races underway in all three states, the result points to a political risk for an industry whose billionaires are spending heavily to influence US elections: their money may make the candidates they back less appealing.
